entities.name: Abu Zayyan Muhammad I
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Zayyan Muhammad ibn Abi Said Uthman ibn Yaghmurasan, known as Abu Zayyan Muhammad I, was the third Zayyanid Sultan of the Kingdom of Tlemcen. He succeeded his father Abu Said Uthman I on June 6, 1304.
